# jamfplatform_pro_webhook (Data Source)

Look up a Jamf Pro webhook by ID or by exact name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be supplied. The plaintext password is never surfaced; `header` is returned (the server echoes it) and marked sensitive.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Global settings | Webhooks | Read | `webhooks` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a webhook by exact name.
data "jamfplatform_pro_webhook" "by_name" {
  name = "Check-in (basic auth)"
}

# Look up a webhook by ID.
data "jamfplatform_pro_webhook" "by_id" {
  id = "66"
}

output "webhook_url" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_pro_webhook.by_name.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Webhook ID. Mutually exclusive with `name`.
- `name` (String) Display name (exact match). Mutually exclusive with `id`.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `authentication_type` (String) Authentication type (NONE, BASIC, HEADER, HASH_SIGNATURE, or MTLS for UI-created webhooks).
- `connection_timeout` (Number) Connection timeout in seconds.
- `content_type` (String) Payload content type.
- `display_fields` (Set of String) Display field names included in the group-object payload.
- `enable_display_fields_for_group_object` (Boolean) Whether display fields are included for the group object.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is active.
- `event` (String) Triggering event.
- `hash_algorithm` (String) HASH_SIGNATURE algorithm.
- `header` (String, Sensitive) HEADER authentication JSON metadata.
- `read_timeout` (Number) Read timeout in seconds.
- `smart_group_id` (Number) Associated smart group ID for SmartGroup* events (null otherwise).
- `url` (String) The URL the payload is posted to.
- `username` (String) BASIC authentication username.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
